question: Which Indian cricketer announced his retirement from all kinds of competitive cricket in December 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Harbhajan Singh__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Harbhajan Singh**

 
 
• The **Indian International cricketer**, **Harbhajan Singh** announced his **retirement** **from all kinds of competitive cricket in December 2021**.
 
• Also known as **Bhajji **and** Turbanator**, his main role in the team was as a **right-arm spin bowler**.
 
• He made his Test and One Day International (ODI) **debuts** in **early 1998**.
 
• He participated in the victory of the Indian cricket team in the **ICC T20 World Cup of 2007** and **ODI World Cup of 2011**.
 
• He was also a part of **Mumbai Indians, Chennai Super Kings** and **Kolkata Knight Riders** teams in different seasons of the **Indian Premier League (IPL)**.
 
• He took **417 wickets in 103 Test matches** and **269 wickets in 236 ODIs**.
